stories.title: DVSA told to stop using A494 Aston Hill lorry check spot after no approval record found
stories.summary: DVSA officers were told to stop using a roadside spot on the A494 at Aston Hill to wait for lorries, after the Welsh Government said it could find no record that they had ever been allowed to. stories.title: Broughton South councillor’s flood report motion rejected again
stories.summary: A strategic report on flooding issues in Flintshire which has been gathering dust for two years has been rejected by the County Council as ‘out of date’. stories.title: Welsh Government urged to keep free milk for 80,000 primary school children after Senedd vote
stories.summary: Ministers are under pressure to keep free school milk for 80,000 primary school children in Wales, after Senedd Members backed a call to rule out axing the scheme. stories.title: Specsavers in Mold to create six jobs in £600,000 expansion
stories.summary: The High Street opticians is taking over the former Hope House charity shop next door, adding a seventh testing room and a dedicated audiology room.

stories.title: Business Wales funding to be halved as money moves to new Welsh development agency
stories.summary: Funding for Business Wales, the Welsh Government’s advice service for small firms, is set to be halved next year, with money moved towards a new development agency that has yet to be set up.
